maddeler.e:
نقتعد (form VIII)
# نَقْتَعِدُ (naqtaʕidu) /naq.ta.ʕi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# نُقْتَعَدُ (nuqtaʕadu) /nuq.ta.ʕa.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# نَقْتَعِدَ (naqtaʕida) /naq.ta.ʕi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# نُقْتَعَدَ (nuqtaʕada) /nuq.ta.ʕa.da/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
